verdict.rationale: Puzzle has an API built for platform-to-platform integrations and embedded accounting, and its docs confirm a full general ledger can be exported in Excel and CSV on cash or accrual basis. However, that export is described as a product feature, not an API endpoint, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. The MCP integration gives conversational access to financial data, not a documented programmatic GL or trial-balance pull. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for general ledger and trial balance retrieval, any mention of trial balance at all, public API reference/OpenAPI spec, API response formats, independent corroboration.
